biography:
As a business leader, my focus is on supporting our customers in optimizing their organization's digital infrastructure and driving long-term success. With over 20 years of experience in the technology industry, my passion lies in working collaboratively with customers and key technology partners to achieve their goals.
 
At Equinix, I’m currently the Senior Vice President of EMEA Sales, where I lead a team dedicated to delivering digital infrastructure solutions that empower businesses in the region to succeed on their digital transformation journey. Our expertise in AI-ready data centers, secure connectivity, and hybrid multicloud environments ensures that businesses can achieve optimal performance, scalability, and efficiency. By addressing their critical IT needs and cultivating strategic technology partners to build complex solutions, my team and I help our customers innovate, expand globally, and maintain business continuity, all while ensuring compliance with industry regulations.
 
Prior to Equinix, I spent 12 fulfilling years at IBM, where in my last role I served as Worldwide Vice President of Sales for IBM Security. In this role, I guided the transformation of our go-to-market and channel strategies, empowering teams worldwide to offer cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. My career has spanned multiple leadership positions across Europe, Asia-Pacific, and North America, including roles at MRO Software and QAD.
 
In my work, I consistently prioritize innovation, customer success, and sustainable practices. These values enable me to support businesses effectively as they navigate the ever-evolving digital landscape. By staying true to these principles, I strive to be a dependable partner for organizations in their journey towards digital transformation.
